A [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] '''battle droid''' that served aboard [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]], the ''[[Malevolence]]'', survived the [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] crash on the [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|Dead Moon of Antar]]<ref name="BS" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was destroyed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Breakout Squad]].<ref name="BS" />
